_comment: Push notification credentials for the home node. Copy this file to <profileDir>/push-config.json and fill in your values. For dev, you can also set env vars (APNS_KEY_ID, FCM_PROJECT_ID, etc.) — env vars take priority over this file. The profile dir is typically ~/Library/Application Support/EnvoyMesh on macOS, ~/.local/share/EnvoyMesh on Linux.
